scope: Dijkstra's BBODY, CERTS (with Dijkstra's CERT, POOL and GOVCERT) and GOV of the Leios testnet build, each applied on its own with every check run: BBODY over the devnet's Dijkstra blocks on the default ledger state, CERTS on the default certificate state, GOV after a CERTS setup on the default store of proposals; not LEDGER, UTXOW, UTXO, ENTITIES or the SUB rules
